blocks.text: Huize Dina's own archive — case files, photographs, correspondence and care records — was probably lost during the war. What survives are the reports, case files and institutional correspondence of others. We therefore work with fragments, aware that violence erased both lives and knowledge, reducing complex stories to scattered traces.
"At the same time, it is profoundly shaped by absence. Many photographs cannot be connected to identified individuals, and the voices of the girls themselves are almost entirely missing." — Naomi
